irac.issue: Whether the disinvestment of the government shareholding in the Bharat Aluminium Company Limited (BALCO) requires the approval of the Parliament, and whether the decision to disinvest without such approval is valid.
irac.rule: The rule of law that emerges is that the government while dealing with the public resources, has to act in a manner that is fair, transparent, and not arbitrary.
irac.application: The court applied the rule to the facts of the case and held that the decision to disinvest in BALCO without Parliamentary approval was not in conformity with the constitutional scheme.
irac.conclusion: The court concluded that the disinvestment of government shareholding in BALCO without Parliamentary approval was not valid.
